name: Collagen
short: In osteoarthritis trials the most reported adverse events were mild to moderate gastrointestinal complaints; a review of 11 skin trials reported no adverse events.
text: In a systematic review of eight studies of collagen derivatives in osteoarthritis, the most reported adverse events were mild to moderate gastrointestinal complaints. A systematic review of 11 randomised placebo-controlled trials of oral collagen supplements for skin (805 patients) reported no adverse events. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
